title: Sierra Leone concludes national workshop to develop the new Health Sector Strategic Plan 2026–2030
note: Documents the national planning process and its emphasis on primary health care, community delivery, workforce, infrastructure and supply chains.

title: National Health Compact — Sierra Leone
org: Government of Sierra Leone / World Bank
note: Sets out a system-wide reform direction toward UHC, stronger primary care, workforce professionalisation, financing reform and digital innovation.

title: WHO Sierra Leone Annual Report 2025
note: Summarises health-system priorities and the development of the 2026–2030 strategic cycle.

title: National Health Sector Strategic Plan 2021–2025
org: Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Sierra Leone
note: Historical baseline for the outgoing strategic framework. Used as context, not as proof of current implementation.

title: Case 2: The family doctor and nurse programme in Cuba
note: Describes territorial responsibility, doctor–nurse teams, polyclinic support, referral and follow-up as a people- and community-centred PHC model.

title: Cuba’s primary health care revolution: 30 years on
org: Bulletin of the World Health Organization
note: Historical overview of the community polyclinic and family doctor–nurse architecture.

title: Rwanda: a primary health care case study in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic
org: WHO Alliance for Health Policy and Systems Research
note: Country-level PHC case study using the Astana framework.

title: Rwanda’s primary health care strategy improves access to essential and life-saving health services
note: Describes health posts as an interface between community health workers, health centres and referral hospitals.

title: Health governance: country illustrations from Costa Rica and Georgia
note: Describes Costa Rica’s integrated primary care model based on multiprofessional EBAIS teams embedded in communities and supported by referral networks.

title: Primary health care
note: WHO overview of PHC as integrated services, multisectoral action and empowered communities.

title: WHO guideline on health policy and system support to optimize community health worker programmes
note: Evidence-informed guidance on integrating and supporting community health workers.

title: Allied Health Professions Act, 2022
note: Statutory anchor for allied-health professional and relevant facility regulation.

title: Unsalaried health workers in Sierra Leone: a scoping review
org: International Journal for Equity in Health
note: Peer-reviewed synthesis on unsalaried health workers and implications for access, accountability and workforce planning.

title: Sierra Leone launches National Healthcare Quality and Patient Safety Policy documents
note: Documents the national quality and patient-safety policy framework.

title: National Community Health Worker Policy 2021
org: Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Sierra Leone
note: Defines CHWs as part of Sierra Leone's PHC system and includes community mapping, household registers, routine home visits, referral, PHU linkage and counter-referral expectations.

title: WHO 2nd Quarter Newsletter 2026 — Sierra Leone
note: Reports that the NHSSP 2026–2030 was aligned and validated, nationwide Health Benefit Package mapping was completed, and facility supervision surfaced stockouts, cold-chain failures and staffing gaps.

title: WHO and Sierra Leone parliament forge partnership for sustainable Health Financing and Universal Health Coverage
note: Documents the development of a National Health Financing Strategy 2026–2030 and the policy push toward stronger domestic financing for UHC.

title: Sierra Leone moves closer to Universal Health Coverage with high-level engagement on draft SLAUHC Bill
note: Describes the proposed UHC agency intended to integrate the Free Healthcare Initiative and Sierra Leone Social Health Insurance Scheme; implementation status must be separately verified.

title: Sierra Leone Service Delivery Indicators Health Survey 2018
note: National facility survey measuring provider effort, clinical knowledge and availability of medicines, infrastructure and equipment. Historical implementation evidence rather than a current facility census.

title: Sierra Leone Essential Health Services Package 2022
org: Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Sierra Leone
note: Explains the intended relationship between the Essential Health Services Package and a progressively costed health benefit package for UHC.

title: National Hospital Strategy for Service Delivery Transformation 2025–2030
note: Current national strategy for hospital service-delivery transformation. Used to keep the model's referral and hospital layer compatible with national direction.

title: Walking the Talk: Reimagining Primary Health Care After COVID-19
note: Provides comparative PHC team examples, including Costa Rica's geographically assigned EBAIS teams and team composition.
